Marta: Weekly BlueHarbor check-in — can someone paste last 7d cache hit rate, median batch size, and cost/1k tokens? Renewal risk flagged if spend >20% above forecast. Need decision on enablement workshop.
ops-bot: Grafana snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/abc123/blueharbor-cache?from=now-7d&to=now :satellite:
Leo (Solutions): Quick snapshot: 7d hit rate 32% (was 28% last week). median batch size = 3. p95 latency = 180ms. cost/1k tokens = $2.14 estimate (hosted). See small chart: https://dash/blueharbor
Ajay (Infra): Saw a retry spike 2026-03-15 02:12 UTC — ~3k retries -> transient 503s from fallback, not cache. Investigating root cause, looks like client timeout + backoff config.
Kira (CSM): BlueHarbor said they only enabled prefix caching on 2 endpoints (search & recommendations). They're open to a 30–45min enablement + runbook session next Tue.
Marta: Can we model cost impact if hit rate moves to 45%? Leo, can you do a quick back-of-envelope?
Leo (Solutions): Back-of-envelope: current tokens/day = 18,000,000. At $2.14/1k -> ~$38,520/mo. If hit_rate +13ppt -> saved tokens ≈ 2.34M/day -> ~$6k/mo savings. I'll produce exact numbers for the deck.
Leo (Solutions): SQL I ran:
```sql
SELECT date, SUM(tokens) as tokens, SUM(cached_tokens) as cached, ROUND(100.0*SUM(cached_tokens)/SUM(tokens),2) as hit_rate
FROM token_metrics
WHERE tenant='blueharbor' AND date >= current_date - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY date;
```
Ajay (Infra): Batch size distribution (7d): 1:62%, 2:20%, 3+:18%. Suggest increasing batching window from 30ms -> 60ms in staging to nudge more 2-3 batches.
Leo (Solutions): Note: 60ms window adds ~30ms to p95. BlueHarbor SLA allows up to 250ms p95 so still within tolerance.
Kira (CSM): I'll confirm the SLA tolerance and preferences. Customer asked for a 1‑pager + runbook with rollback steps and expected savings.
Marta: Action items:
• Leo: prepare 1‑page cost model + 2-slide enablement summary by Thu
• Ajay: run 60ms batching experiment in staging and share perf numbers
• Kira: schedule workshop + send 1‑pager to customer
Recheck on Fri sync. :thumbsup:
Leo (Solutions): Adding note — we should also capture customer feedback during workshop to tune prefix caching heuristics (prefix length, TTL).
Kira (CSM): Will add feedback form to calendar invite.
ops-bot: Reminder set for follow-up: 2026-03-19 15:00 UTC
Marta: Thanks team — flag if any blockers before Thu.
